name: Cindervane
lore: A proud ember phoenix. Close wing cuts bank up to three feathers; spend the rhythm on a curving ascent. Glowing tail embers and unfurled wings mark its flight.

primary.name: Wing Cuts
primary.description: Two timed wing cuts, 12 damage each. Land a cut to bank a feather (up to three).

secondary.name: Cinder Ascent
secondary.description: Banked feathers extend a curling leap, each adds 35 reach. Land for 20 damage and burn. The phoenix unfurls its wings.

special.name: Phoenix Ring
special.description: Three rotating wing sweeps over 1.2s, each 10 damage and burn. Spend all banked feathers to heal 3 HP per feather. Leave a stationary smoke ring for 5.5 seconds; allied heroes inside have a 12% chance to dodge each incoming direct hit. Does not dodge damage-over-time.

passive: Ash Rebirth: on defeat, return at the same spot after 3 seconds with 50% maximum health. Once per 120 seconds; unlocked at level 5.

technique.name: Patient Wings

attack.name: Patient Wings
attack.description: Two heavier cuts, 15 each; longer recovery.

technique.description: Longer reach and heavier cuts, slower rhythm.

final_technique.name: Ash Nest

attack.name: Ash Nest
attack.description: Leave a six-second ash nest. Allies inside heal 3 HP/sec; enemies take 3 burn damage/sec.

final_technique.description: Trade the three offensive sweeps for a small stationary refuge.
